vocabulary.meaning: a bag, often provided by a shop, used to carry purchases
examples: Carrier bag is an important idea when discussing plastic carrier bags.
Learning about carrier bag can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: plastic designed to be used once before disposal
examples: People often have different views about single-use plastic when discussing plastic carrier bags.
Understanding single-use plastic can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a durable bag designed to be used many times
examples: The topic of plastic carrier bags raises useful questions about reusable bag.
We can discuss how reusable bag affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: discarded plastic material that can cause environmental problems
examples: Plastic waste can play an important role in debates about plastic carrier bags.
Different countries may deal with plastic waste in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: an official charge or tax placed on a product or activity
examples: A discussion about plastic carrier bags can include the effects of levy.
Knowing the meaning of levy makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: the process of converting waste into materials that can be used again
examples: Recycling is useful vocabulary for talking about plastic carrier bags.
We can use the idea of recycling to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
